ticks.note: Tick 1 enters S; the self-loop is delayed, so random() has not been called yet: r = 0, percent = 0.

random() is C's rand() / RAND_MAX, computed in single precision. The simulation never seeds the generator, so the sequence is the same on every run (glibc: 1804289383, 846930886, ...): r = 0.8401877284049988, percent = (int)(0.3943829 * 100) = 39. Each call takes the next number.
